card.name: Digits before physical units
card.fires_on: Digits or unit symbols inside a measurement just before a unit such as km, kW, mL, or K, mostly in geology, geography, and engineering specifications. Also on 'of' before temperature and pressure ranges.

modes.label: Digits before a unit
modes.description: The last digit of a number just before km, kW, km2, or mL.
modes.example: Within the depth range of 5-1<<0>>km pseudotachylite is formed

modes.label: Unit symbol in a rate
modes.description: The unit symbol or slash in a temperature lapse rate or similar compound unit.

modes.label: Range of physical conditions
modes.description: The word 'of' leading into a range of temperature and pressure.
modes.example: specific range<< of>> temperature and pressure during a metamorphic event

card.writes: It suppresses tokens starting with the letter T, so it seems to push against a T-word following the number, which weakly favors a measurement unit.
